expo.name: WonderTales
expo.description: Parent-managed AI storytelling for families, with child profiles, optional parent-provided reference photos, illustrated stories, narration, and parent-controlled sharing.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WonderTales can let a parent take an optional reference photo for a story character when the parent starts that photo flow.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: WonderTales uses microphone access only if a parent records optional audio for a story.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WonderTales lets parents choose photos they have the right to use as optional references for safe, fictional, illustrated story characters.

plugins.photosPermission: WonderTales lets parents choose photos they have the right to use as optional references for safe, fictional, illustrated story characters.
